# Billora

> Your municipal accounts, together. A browser-local municipal account organiser for South Africa.

Billora helps homeowners, tenants, landlords and businesses organise municipal statements and properties. It is an independent application, not a municipal authority or payment processor.

## Product

- Four screens: Overview, Properties, Statements and Insights.
- Import a PDF up to 15 MB. Text extraction runs on the device; users review and enter totals, statement periods, due dates and optional category amounts.
- Original PDFs live in IndexedDB; account metadata and preferences live in localStorage.
- Calendar reminders download as ICS files. Query letters are drafts downloaded as text; they are not lodged automatically.
- Payment buttons link to official municipal portals. Billora does not accept payments or verify settlement.
- The initial accounts are labelled illustrative sample data, dated May–October 2026. Settings can clear the workspace before entering real accounts.
- Light, dark and system themes, reduced motion, hidden balances, offline app shell and PWA installation support.

## Data meaning

Balances are imported or illustrative, never verified live municipal balances. A personal “marked paid” flag is not a payment confirmation. Spending charts use imported category amounts; unallocated amounts are labelled accordingly. Insights do not establish billing errors.

## Privacy and limitations

Cloud account and authorised municipal integration demonstrations are clearly labelled DEMO INTEGRATION and run only in the browser. Made-up demo profiles and consent records use localStorage; sync results are fixtures with demo: true and no live connection. Demo balances do not alter imported statements. There is no real cloud account, authentication, cross-device sync, background push notification or private municipal integration in this release. Browser-local storage is not an encrypted vault. Data may be lost if browser storage is cleared. Export account JSON and keep original PDF copies. Do not assume a hosted deployment provides server-side statement storage.

- [Repository](https://github.com/thembaxx/billora): source code, setup and implementation notes.
- [Theming reference](https://web.dev/learn/design/theming): browser and system theme guidance.
